name: Fold
author: Emilie Gillet
description: Braids' two wavefolders crossfaded against each other, the sine one saturating where the triangle one keeps folding. The model Plaits' waveshaping engine descends from, with the second curve it left behind.

controls.label: Blend
controls.description: Crossfades from the sine folder, which saturates, to the triangle folder, which keeps folding.

controls.label: Fold
controls.description: Sets how hard both folders are driven, from a barely bent wave to the module's full depth.

controls.label: Symmetry
controls.description: Offsets the wave into one half of the folder, adding the even harmonics a symmetric source cannot make.

controls.label: Drive
controls.description: Pushes the folders past the depth the module stops at, or holds them back below it.

outputs.aux: The complementary crossfade, always favouring the folder MAIN does not.

upstream: Braids MacroOscillator::RenderSineTriangle over AnalogOscillator::RenderSineFold and RenderTriangleFold
